description: Compare 2 to 5 nursing homes side by side from CMS Care Compare: the four star ratings, nurse and RN hours per resident per day, staff turnover, health deficiencies in the latest inspection cycle, fines, abuse icon and Special Focus status, with the leader on each measure and the state averages.

facilities.description: 2 to 5 facilities, each as {ccn} or {name, state}.

ccn.description: CMS Certification Number (6 characters, e.g. 475014), from nursing_home_search. Most exact.

city.description: City, to narrow a name match.

name.description: Facility name or part of it, if no ccn.

state.description: State as a two-letter code (VT) or name (Vermont).

name: nursing_home_compare
title: Compare nursing homes
